{{Top|leg}}
'''Para-sails''' were a vehicle of deployment used by [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]]. Trainees were instructed in the methods of deploying into combat via the use of para-sails. They could also be used recreationally, with many SpecForce personnel opting to go [[para-sailing]] while on leave.<ref name="ROE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>
